commits_info.message:
2.16.1 release (previous 2.16.0) + release notes updated by CI build 3261

[ci skip-release]

Merge pull request #1258 from mockito/singleton-lock

Prevent class loading race condition

Fixes #1067

Simplified locking during class generation

Let's optimise the implementation for correctness rather than performance. Especially if we don't have evidence that using classloader objects as the monitor makes Mockito faster. I made tests on our own build and the execution of tests takes exactly the same.
Addresses #1067: offer singleton class loading lock to avoid loading races.

issues.title: Deadlock after upgrading to Mockito 2 and parallel tests execution
